model_annotations.English: Figure 6 presents a comparison of massive activations and attention sink phenomena across different gating configurations in a neural network model. The figure consists of two line plots, each with a shared x-axis labeled "Layer" that ranges from 0 to 22 in integer steps, and a y-axis labeled "Max" on the left plot and "First token" on the right plot, both with a linear scale. The left plot displays three lines: a red line with square markers that starts at a value of 0, rises sharply to a peak of approximately 400 around layer 6, and then declines; a green line with triangle markers that remains at a low value of approximately 100 until layer 10, after which it rises to a peak of about 250 at layer 22; and a blue line with circle markers that remains flat at a value of 0 across all layers. The right plot shows a single line, which is blue with circle markers, starting at a value of 0, remaining flat until layer 10, and then rising sharply to a value of approximately 1.2 at layer 22. The figure's caption explains that Row 1 (Baseline) shows significant massive activations and attention sinks emerging after the 6th layer, Row 2 (SDPA Gating) shows reduced activations and no attention sinks, Row 3 (Value Layer Gating) shows similar activations to Row 2 but with residual attention sinks, and Rows 4–5 (Reduced Sparsity via cross-head share and NS-sigmoid) show massive activations and attention sinks that resemble the baseline.
model_annotations.German: Figure 6 presents a comparison of massive activations and attention sink phenomena across different gating configurations, with the x-axis representing the layer number ranging from 0 to 22 on a linear scale, and the y-axis representing the magnitude of activations, scaled from 0 to 400. The figure contains multiple line plots, each corresponding to a different gating configuration. The first plot, labeled as Row 1 (Baseline), shows a red line that remains near zero until layer 6, after which it sharply increases to a peak of approximately 400 at layer 22. The second plot, Row 2 (SDPA Gating), displays a green line that remains flat at zero until layer 6, then rises to a peak of about 200 at layer 10, followed by a decline to around 100 at layer 22. The third plot, Row 3 (Value Layer Gating), features a blue line that stays near zero until layer 6, then increases to a peak of approximately 200 at layer 10, and then decreases to about 100 at layer 22. The remaining plots, Rows 4–5 (Reduced Sparsity via cross-head share and NS-sigmoid), show lines that resemble the baseline, with activations rising sharply after layer 6 and peaking at around 400 at layer 22.
